mapper.select: select u.id, u.dept_id, u.nickname, u.username, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.sex, u.enable, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_time, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark, d.dept_name, d.leader, u1.username as leaderName from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.id left join sys_user u1 on u1.user_id = d.leader ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}

select distinct u.id, u.dept_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.email, u.phonenumber, u.enable, u.create_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.id left join sys_user_role sur on u.id = sur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.id = sur.role_id ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}

select distinct u.id, u.dept_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.email, u.phonenumber, u.enable, u.create_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.id left join sys_user_role sur on u.id = sur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.id = sur.role_id ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
